children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 1, with investors reacting to corporate developments.

Religare Enterprises share price rose more than 3% after Ashish Dhawan bought more than 36 lakh shares, representing 1.05 percent of the paid-up equity, for Rs 85.3 crore at a price of Rs 237 per share. His total stake in Religare Enterprises increased to more than 7 percent, compared with the 5.24 percent stake he held as of June 2026.

E2E Networks shares rose more than 3% on entering into a binding term sheet with an India-based Sovereign AI company for NVIDIA Blackwell cloud GPUs and allied services. The arrangement has a contract value of approximately Rs 1,000 crore and will continue through June 2029.

Shares of NLC India gained nearly 2% after its subsidiary, NLC India Renewables, has incorporated a joint venture company with the Odisha Renewable Energy Development Agency (OREDA), named NIRL OREDA Renewables, for setting up green energy power plants, with equity participation of 51:49.
Share price of PVR INOX rose 2% after board approved a proposal to buy back up to 20.69 lakh equity shares worth Rs 300 crore at a price of Rs 1,450 per share.

Sectoral indices traded mixed, with Nifty Realty declining 2.15%, followed by Nifty Consumer Durables down 1.36%, Nifty Pharma lower 1.28%, and Nifty Bank falling 1.19%, while Nifty Private Bank, PSU Bank and Energy shed 1.14%, 0.82% and 0.65%, respectively.
The broader market trading lower, with Nifty Midcap index down 1 percent and smallcap index shed 0.5 percent.
Market breadth remained weak on the BSE, with 1515 shares advancing, 1707 declining and 168 remaining unchanged, indicating a broadly negative trend across the broader market.

title: Price Action | Religare Enterprises shares rise 3% as Ashish Dhawan raises stake; PVR INOX gains 2% on buyback approval
